## Recent work
Search rebuild was optimized and validated: embedding requests are chunked, scans are tenant-scoped, management commands share the embedder, and vector writes are bulk-upserted. Migration `ledgerly/db/migrations/0042_add_search_vector_tenant_document.py` adds the required unique tenant/document index. Full tests passed: 247 passed, 4 skipped. A 10,000-document benchmark reached median 2.41s, p95 2.88s versus 16.73s previously.

Fixed CSV output by explicitly opening reports as UTF-8 in `ledgerly/exporters/csv_export.py`; all 7 CSV tests passed, and the generated file reports `charset=utf-8`.

Before further edits under `ledgerly/migrations/` or `ledgerly/db/migrations/`, ping `@dana-db` in `#prod-db-changes`. Keep commits small. Tax changelog entries require the Jira issue key in parentheses and the `tax-doc` label.
